section_header: LUBRICATION SYSTEM — Replacement of Engine Oil and Oil Filter
title: REPLACEMENT OF ENGINE OIL AND OIL FILTER

items.heading: DRAIN ENGINE OIL
items.text: Remove the oil drain plug and drain the oil into a container.

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Using SST, remove the oil filter (located on right side of the engine block).

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Inspect and clean the oil filter installation surface.

substeps.label: (c)
substeps.text: Apply clean engine oil to the gasket of the new oil filter.

substeps.label: (d)
substeps.text: Lightly screw in the oil filter to where you feel resistance.

substeps.label: (e)
substeps.text: Then, using SST, tighten the oil filter an extra 3/4 turn.

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Clean and install the oil drain plug with a new gasket.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Fill the engine with new oil API grade SF or SF/CC, multigrade, fuel efficient and recommended viscosity oil.

rows.condition: Drain and refill w/o Oil filter change

items.heading: START ENGINE AND CHECK FOR LEAKS
RECHECK ENGINE OIL LEVEL
items.text: Recheck the engine oil level and refill as necessary.

note.text: NOTE: Insert the oil level gauge with the curved tip pointed toward the engine.
